name: Safety tip (portrait)
description: A high-visibility safety tip for factories, warehouses, kitchens and sites: a warning icon on a safety-yellow panel, the rule in big type, up to four how-to steps and who to call. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: icon
params.label: Icon
params.help: A square PNG or SVG with a transparent background, dark enough to read on the accent panel.

params.name: tip_number
params.label: Tip number
params.help: Under the panel title, e.g. "TIP 14 OF 52". Leave empty to hide.

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: Who or where it is for.

params.name: headline
params.label: Tip
params.help: The rule in a few words.
params.default: Lift with your legs, not your back

params.name: steps
params.label: How to
params.help: Up to four short lines; Enter starts a new line. Keep each under about 45 characters.
params.default:
1. Stand close, feet shoulder-width apart
2. Bend your knees and keep your back straight
3. Grip firmly and lift without twisting
4. Over 23 kg? Use a trolley or ask a colleague

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.help: Who to call or where to report.
params.default: Report every near-miss to your supervisor or call the safety line on ext. 2240

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Off hides the logo and its space stays empty.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background, in a light colour for the default dark background.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The panel behind the icon, the small heading and the rule.

params.name: background
params.label: Background colour
params.help: The page. The panel title and tip number are drawn in this colour too.
